authority: Original Word remains authoritative; Chinese default is the explicit user override. Checklist guides verification. Meowdoku observation is not a frozen Pawdoku baseline.
changes: Immediate non-writing contact highlight uses the existing recognizers; committed X draws in and removal fades/shrinks. Double-tap arbitration and Core are unchanged.

Correct committed cells pop with a ring and up to four stars travel to the found-count pill; pill pulses on arrival. Actual positive score deltas and repeated same-tier Combo acknowledgement are shown.
Combo moved to a reserved slot above the board after screenshot review found overlap with the level number. Board remains square with no scroll ancestor.

Next/revive/restart actions enter immediately. Only result decoration waits briefly to expose final-cell feedback; Core state, saving and input locking remain immediate. Restored/background/reduced-motion results bypass decorative waiting.

Retained prepared UIKit haptic generators; light mark/undo/swipe throttle, distinct accepted correct/error/win patterns, no extra Combo pulse; switches and page/overlay/ad/background/interruption gates apply.
Session replacement, background and hiding clear transient feedback; old callbacks cannot remove new effects. Internal motion override and UIKit reduce-motion configuration are connected.
